description: Changes to the RAG core explicitly approved by the project owner. Every other file in rag_core_baseline.json must still match its recorded hash. The path was re-keyed from hr_assistant/hybird_search.py to rag/retriever.py by the Phase 2 migration; the recorded line, line number and both hashes are unchanged.

rag/retriever.py.reason: Off-by-one: Qdrant payload 'index' is 1-based (labor_law_parsed.json) but was used directly as a 0-based position in dense_scores, crediting each semantic hit to the next article and dropping hits on the last article. The fix matches the form evaluated in search_evaluation.ipynb (index - 1).
rag/retriever.py.fixed_line: idx = (r.node.metadata.get("index") or 0) - 1  # stored "index" is 1-based; dense_scores is 0-based
